questions.question: All entry points along the trail

analyses.content: 录音明确指出，步道上的20个入口（entry points）都通过短路径连接到公共道路（public roads），因此B选项正确。
你可能听到“shuttle bus”和“free car park”就想选A或C，但这两种设施分别只在“2个终点”和“4个入口”提供，并不能代表题干问的“所有（All）”入口。

You can hike the whole length of the trail or just a couple of miles, because there are 20 entry points along the trail, each connected to public roads by short paths. For hikers coming from Johnson City, there's a shuttle bus to each of the 2 end points every morning and evening. And 4 of the entry points have a free car park with television camera surveillance.

questions.question: Which facility at the trail rest stations has been added as a result of a user survey?

analyses.content: 录音提到，在对徒步者进行调查（poll）后，最近在休息站新安装了提供清晰地图和其他步道信息（maps and other trail information）的设施。
你可能会因为听到前一句的“recharge”或“picnic areas”而选A或B，但录音明确这些是休息站原本就有的配置，并不是根据“用户调查（poll of walkers）”结果新增加的。

At one-mile intervals along the trail, there are rest stations providing picnic areas, water, toilets, and places where you can recharge your electronic devices. In response to a poll of walkers last year, we've recently installed kiosks at each rest station with clear, easy-to-follow maps and other trail information.

questions.question: On the Red Rock Walk, hikers are easily able to

analyses.content: 录音指出红岩步道提供了极好的机会，可以研究沿途种类繁多的植被（vegetation对应plants）。
你可能听到“Birds”就想选C，但录音紧接着强调鸟类“实际上很难被发现（hard to spot）”，这与题干中要求的“容易（easily able to）”完全相反。

The Red Rock Walk offers a superb opportunity to study a huge variety of vegetation along the way. There's lots to look at, though you can't see great distances. Birds are actually hard to spot, but with a pair of binoculars and at certain times of day, you may see some rare varieties.

questions.question: What does the speaker say about the River Walk in wintertime?

analyses.content: 录音明确提到，如果天气条件极度不合适，可能不得不对公众“关闭（close）”这条步道，意味着步道可能无法使用。
你可能听到“discourage visitors”想选A，或者听到“freeze”想当然认为天冷没人，但录音中“doesn't always”和“often...crowded”明确否定了这点，表示这里冬天依然经常挤满游客。

Personally, I prefer this section of the trail in winter. The river does freeze over, and the snow can accumulate, but that doesn't always discourage visitors. Sometimes, though, if the weather conditions are really unsuitable, we might have to close this walk to the public. But often, it can get crowded with hikers who've discovered the attraction of the area.

analyses.content: 录音说明宿舍床位是“按人们到达的顺序来分配（allocate them as people arrive）”，完全对应“先到先得（first-come-first-served basis）”的逻辑。
你可能一听到“pre-booking”就想选F（需要提前预订），但录音明确说这种方法“不管用（didn't work）”，听力中遇到原词重现一定要警惕其前后的否定词。

Of course, there are beds in dormitories for use at a very reasonable 7 dollars per person, weekdays or weekends. Unfortunately, we found that pre-booking beds just didn't work, so now we allocate them as people arrive. But we have extra cots and sleeping bags to help with any overflow.
录音明确要求，针对家庭套房你需要“提前做好安排（make arrangements ahead of time）”，直接对应需要提前预订。
你可能听到“especially at the weekends”就粗心选了A（仅在周末），但这句话的意思是家庭套房在周末“极其受欢迎”，而不是只在周末开放。

There are 2 family rooms accommodating 6 people each with private bathrooms. They're 35 dollars per room, and for them, you will need to make arrangements ahead of time as they're very popular, especially at the weekends.
录音提到投币式洗衣机是“最近增加的（recently added）”一项设施，完美对应选项中的“新设备（new equipment）”。
你可能会把注意力全放在找衣服清洗的功能上，而忽略了“coin-operated（投币式）”这个前提词，千万别自我引申去选E（免费提供）。

A popular facility that we've recently added is coin-operated washing machines for your clothes. You can get awfully wet and dirty if you're walking the trail in bad weather, and since we got these machines, you can put on clean gear when you set out in the morning.
录音提出请求，希望客人能“帮把手（give a hand）”参与上菜和饭后的清理工作，对应请求客人帮忙。
你可能在听到“kids”时就急着去选I（儿童特价），但录音紧接着说的是成人和儿童的价格“是一样的（the same）”。

The hostel serves 2 meals a day, breakfast at 4 dollars and dinner at 8 dollars, the same for adults and kids. There's always a vegetarian and a non-vegetarian option, depending on your preferences. We do ask you to give a hand with serving and cleaning up after meals.
录音非常直白地告诉你，你可以“不花钱（at no charge）”享受充足的淋浴和无限量的热水，对应免费提供。
你可能觉得“无限热水”这种福利肯定有限制条件，但一定不要用常识代替听力内容，抓住核心词“no charge”即可。
We have plenty of showers and unlimited hot water available, so you can have this luxury at no charge, and you can enjoy it as long as you like.
录音指出自行车租赁计划正处于创建过程中，且要到“明年（next year）”才能投入运营，说明当前这项服务还不具备。
你可能听到“bike rental scheme”就以为现在已经有这项服务了，或者是听到“next year”以为是新增加的设备（误选G），切记要听完整句话的时态和时间状语。

Now, some people like to spend time on the trail on mountain bikes and maybe take a bit of a rest from all that walking, and that's permitted as long as you observe basic safety rules. The hostel's in the process of creating a bike rental scheme, which should be up and running next year.
